title: Refine product recommendation cards
summary: Lighter recommendation cards with responsive sizing, consistent product imagery and simpler price presentation.

changes.detail: Refined borders, spacing, typography, square image presentation and responsive card/rail sizing.
Removed heavy boxed price panel and fixed oversized card/image dimensions.
Wishlist and purchase controls now have 44px touch targets in related cards; old prices stack to avoid competing with actions.
